name: Sgeimh Soluis

text: Sgeimh Soluis is an Irish heroine. The great band of warriors called the Fianna lost favor after the death of their leader Fionn Mac Cumhaill. They grew greedy and violent. Sgeimh Soluis was the granddaughter of Cormac Mac Airt, the great king of Tara. Before her marriage she refused to pay tribute to the Fianna. The warriors attacked her. At the battle of Gabhair they met utter defeat. Sgeimh Soluis stands as the woman who broke the Fianna's pride and turned their strength to ruin. Her story survives as a tale of a single refusal that brought down a violent band.
